projectDescription: A local-first task tracker for AI agents, operated entirely through MCP tools — no browser, no GUI, just your AI assistant managing tasks alongside your code.
keyFeatures: Full task lifecycle management with types (task, bug, feature, epic), priorities, estimates, tags, and custom metadata
Subtasks and task linking with blocks, relates_to, and duplicates relationships
Semantic search using local all-MiniLM-L6-v2 ONNX embedding model with hybrid FTS5 + vector mode
Interactive visualizations: Kanban boards, force-directed dependency graphs, and project dashboards
Per-project SQLite isolation — each project gets its own database
Two deployment modes: local stdio (npm install) and self-hosted Docker with multi-user OAuth auth
Full data portability via ZIP archive export and import
Full change history — every task mutation recorded with what changed, old/new values, timestamp, and actor
publicApiSurface: init_project — Initialize a Willet project for the current working directory
get_project — Get the project for the current directory or by project_id
list_projects — List all projects, optionally filtered by name
create_task — Create a new task with optional links and initial comment
update_task — Update an existing task's fields
get_task — Get a task by ID with comments, links, optional history and subtasks
delete_task — Delete a task and all its related data
start_task — Set a task's status to in_progress
complete_task — Mark a task as done
cancel_task — Cancel a task
reopen_task — Reopen a completed or cancelled task
list_tasks — List tasks with structured filtering (status, type, priority, tags, dates, parent)
search_tasks — Search tasks using text (FTS5), semantic (vector), or hybrid mode
get_task_graph — Get a task and all linked tasks up to N hops out
get_project_stats — Get task counts grouped by status, type, and priority
list_tags — List all tags in use with their task counts
add_comment — Add a comment to a task
link_tasks — Create a link between two tasks (blocks, relates_to, duplicates)
unlink_tasks — Remove a link between two tasks
render_task_board — Render a Kanban board grouped by status, priority, or type
render_dependency_graph — Render a dependency graph showing task relationships
